## Updraft 0.7.3

- **ChatGPT can search your meetings too.** Like claude.ai, ChatGPT on the web can now look through your meeting transcripts and AI notes, read-only (on ChatGPT Pro it's search only). It uses the same web access as claude.ai: turn on "Let web apps connect" in Settings > Connectors, add Updraft in ChatGPT's Apps & Connectors with your web address, then type the pairing word and the code. Your own notes and dictation history are never shared with web apps.
- **Screen recording on the Mac is paused for now.** After 0.7.2 it was checked on a Mac: the webcam bubble, hiding Updraft's own controls, playback and the permission prompts all work. But PC sound in videos played slightly fast with small gaps, and dictation started a little slower while a recording used the mic. Until a fix passes the Mac speed check, the Screen recording switch on a Mac is greyed out (if you turned it on, it's off until then). Windows is unchanged.
